data.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
data.sql: WITH RECURSIVE callers AS (SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS current_id, c.caller_symbol_id AS caller_id, 1 AS depth, list_value(c.callee_symbol_id, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM code.calls AS c INNER JOIN code.symbols AS t ON c.callee_symbol_id = t.symbol_id WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') OR c.call_kind = 'callback') UNION ALL SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS current_id, c.caller_symbol_id AS caller_id, w.depth + 1 AS depth, list_append(w.path, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM callers AS w INNER JOIN code.calls AS c ON c.callee_symbol_id = w.caller_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') OR c.call_kind = 'callback') AND NOT list_contains(w.path, c.caller_symbol_id)) SELECT w.caller_id AS symbol_id, MIN(w.depth) AS depth FROM callers AS w INNER JOIN code.symbols AS cs ON cs.symbol_id = w.caller_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE GROUP BY w.caller_id ORDER BY depth, symbol_id
